abstract_sentences.text: Long Context Language Models have drawn great attention in the past few years.

evidence.anchor: Long Context Language Models have drawn great attention

abstract_sentences.text: There has been work discussing the impact of long context on Language Model performance: some find that long irrelevant context could harm performance, while some experimentally summarize loss reduction by relevant long context as Scaling Laws.

evidence.anchor: long irrelevant context could harm performance

abstract_sentences.text: This calls for a more thorough understanding of how long context impacts Language Modeling.

evidence.anchor: a more thorough understanding of how long context impacts Language Modeling

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we (1) propose to use ‘Intrinsic Entropy’ for explaining the impact of context length on language modeling; and (2) conduct experiments on natural language and synthetic data, validating our proposed theoretical assumptions and deductions.

evidence.anchor: propose to use ‘Intrinsic Entropy’

abstract_sentences.text: Our theoretical framework can provide practical insights such as establishing that training dataset size dictates an optimal context length and bounds context length scaling for certain cases.

evidence.anchor: training dataset size dictates an optimal context length

abstract_sentences.text: We hope our work may inspire new long context Language Models, as well as future work studying the physics of Language Models.

evidence.anchor: may inspire new long context Language Models
long context has become crucial for tasks such as reasoning and retrieval
prior work reports mixed outcomes
most of them do not study how context length impacts scaling laws
The total loss is the sum of these 2 components
we introduce Intrinsic Entropy

final_judgment.single_storyline: context length 同时降低 Bayes Risk、提高固定数据/容量模型的 Approximation Loss；Intrinsic Entropy 及其 ID/eigenvalue proxy 把前者的信息增长与后者的表示复杂度连接起来，导数平衡产生 task/model/data-dependent optimal context length。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留混合长上下文现象、Eq. (1)–(5)、三条直觉 entropy assumptions、训练和 downstream 临界点曲线、synthetic Point 1/2 与主要 scope limitation。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Horg/Hexp 定义、formal Intrinsic Space、density/moment 前置条件、Theorem 1–4 proofs、KDE/PCA 细节、RULER/model-size robustness、绝对 validation curves 和 ID/entropy bridge 被移入 Appendix A–K；L 记录 LLM disclosure。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 三联图把抽象分解、dataset-size optimum 右移、downstream critical point 放在同一视觉语境；Figure 5–7 的可控 sparse parity 与 Table 1 的 Bayes-minimum calibration 进一步隔离机制。
final_judgment.largest_gap: Abstract 声称 context-length scaling 在 certain cases 有 bounds，但 theorem 实际给的是 nearest-neighbour/approximation-loss data rate，没有独立的 context-length upper bound 或可应用阈值；此外主文缺少 seed-level uncertainty。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对于非单调 context/scale 主张，应在同一因果链中分别展示不可约信息风险与逼近/容量代价，再用可控 synthetic task 和绝对量校准表验证二者是否分离。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 当 Bayes Model 不可估计、Predictive Consistency/entropy relationship 不成立、task metric 与 next-token CE 脱钩，或 Approximation Loss 不随长度上升时，critical-point 解释只是待检验假设；RULER-vt 与 RecurrentGemma outliers 展示了该边界。
